title: MellinDuality: Mellin duality for the band-parity companion
abstract: For an odd prime p, an odd character chi modulo p and m >= 0, the multiplier family C(a) = sum over 0 < n < p/2 of chi(n) (-1)^(n + <a n^(2m)>) has Fourier transform over the characters 2 sum_a conj(psi)(a) C(a) = G(conj psi) G(chi psi^(2m)), with the multiplier constant G(psi) = sum_m psi(m) (-1)^m = 2 (1 - 2 psi(2)) B_(1,psi). The development proves this Mellin duality over any commutative ring, its inversion over the odd complex characters and its form bilinear in first Bernoulli numbers, the half-sum identity, the exponent family and its two collapses. At p = 5 (mod 8), for the quartic character, it proves the coset decomposition of the family, its exact sums over the cosets of the fourth powers, conjugate dynamics, the two second-moment identities, the decomposition of the second-order products of the band-parity companion by coprime pairs, and Parseval's identity for the band weight. Through the inversion and Parseval's identity over the odd characters it proves, for every a not divisible by p, the exact second moment sum over odd chi of |sum over odd psi of psi(a) (1 - 2 conj(psi)(2)) (1 - 2 chi(2) psi(2)^2) B_(1,conj psi) B_(1,chi psi^2)|^2 = ((p - 1)/2)^4.
